method: Figures were read from the downloaded workbook on the access date by tools/extract_uk_firm_supply_use_tables.py; none was filled from memory. Values are pounds million at current prices as published. Demand is at purchasers' prices (the 'Combined Use' matrix, domestic output and imports together); domestic output is at basic prices. The product -> SIC division rows are parsed from the CPA product codes and checked against the Industry and product map sheet; a product spanning several divisions is repeated once per division with the whole product.
identities_checked: domestic output + imports + distributors' margins + taxes less subsidies = total supply (each product)
intermediate consumption + total final demand = total demand = total supply (each product)
final demand components sum to total final demand (each product)

Table 3 COICOP columns sum to Total (domestic concept); domestic + non-resident expenditure in the UK + resident expenditure abroad = Total HHFCE (national concept) = Table 2 households (each product)
distributors' margins sum to zero over products
products per SIC division = distinct A103 codes per division in the Industry and product map
notes: Table 2's households column is the national concept (includes UK residents' spending abroad, excludes non-residents' spending in the UK, which sits in exports); Table 3's COICOP columns are the domestic concept.
Table 3 publishes COICOP classes for divisions 01-09 and only division totals for 10, 11 and 12 (no 12.6.1 FISIM class).

Distributors' trading margins are negative only on the trade products CPA_G45, CPA_G46 and CPA_G47 and are spread over the goods products (and publishing products J58, J59 & J60) as positive margins; one combined column, not split by wholesale, retail and motor trade.
Table 3 footnote: COICOP data here may differ from Consumer Trends because of the CPA to COICOP correlator; at the total level they are consistent.
Table 3 has 102 product rows: it prints CPA_C27 and CPA_C28 as one row, CPA_C27 & C28, written under that code.
Zero cells of Table 3 are not written to sut_hhfce_product_coicop.csv.

source.edition: Supply and Use Tables, 1997 - 2024 (consistent with UK National Accounts 2026 Blue Book), released October 2026
